extracted_claim: Box2D v3 uses C API with opaque handles (b2WorldId, b2BodyId, b2ShapeId, b2JointId). b2CreateWorld(b2WorldDef*) creates world (up to 128). b2World_Step(worldId, timeStep, subStepCount) runs simulation (collision detection, integration, constraint solution). Default: timeStep=1/60, subStepCount=4. b2World_SetGravity() controls gravity. b2World_GetBodyEvents/SensorEvents/ContactEvents/JointEvents returns transient event data.
implementation_relevance: HSE has no physics. Box2D is the standard 2D physics engine.

document_reference: box2d.h, Body section and Shape section
extracted_claim: Box2D bodies: b2CreateBody(worldId, b2BodyDef*), b2DestroyBody(bodyId). Body types: static, kinematic, dynamic. Body properties: position, rotation, linearVelocity, angularVelocity, mass, inertia, damping, gravityScale. Forces: ApplyForce, ApplyTorque, ApplyLinearImpulse. Shapes: b2CreateCircleShape, b2CreatePolygonShape, b2CreateCapsuleShape, b2CreateSegmentShape. Shape properties: density, friction, restitution, filter. AABB query: b2World_OverlapAABB. Ray cast: b2World_CastRay.
implementation_relevance: Box2D's body/shape separation is the standard physics engine design pattern.

extracted_claim: Box2D v3 supports simulation recording (b2CreateRecording, b2World_StartRecording/StopRecording, b2SaveRecordingToFile) and snapshot/restore (b2World_Snapshot, b2World_Restore, b2CreateWorldFromSnapshot). Snapshots capture full simulation state for rollback/undo/save-games. Snapshots are instant-in-time; recordings are step streams. Restore keeps live world wiring; CreateFromSnapshot resets to defaults.
implementation_relevance: Recording/snapshot is a powerful pattern for HSE's project persistence and undo system.
